speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The Public Service Division (PSD) and all public agencies continually seek to build a better future for our nation and our people.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We aspire to serve Singapore and Singaporeans well through anticipating their needs and delivering services to them in an agile and responsive manner.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will organise ourselves to serve from the people's perspective, not from agencies’ perspective; strengthen the trust and bond with Singaporeans; and uphold the Public Service values of Integrity, Service and Excellence.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: While we develop a long-term plan for the next lap for our Public Service, we will press on with efforts for our agencies to better deliver on the Government’s priorities.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our agencies will go beyond “whole-of-Government” and mobilise “whole-of-nation” efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will partner businesses, citizens and other stakeholders to develop better solutions together.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will continue to actively reach out to others, whether overseas or in the private sector, hear their views, learn from their successes and failures, and improve ourselves along the way.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will communicate clearly and simply to the public and seek to bring everyone on board.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Our comparative advantage is in anticipating needs and responding to challenges.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will champion innovation and testbed new ideas.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will respond quickly to issues and be more efficient, innovative and productive.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will tap on digital technologies as an enabler.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will sharpen and deepen our Public Sector Transformation efforts, making use of, and responding to the disruptions brought on by new technology and business models.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The heart of the Public Service lies in the dedication and abilities of our officers.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: PSD will continue to strengthen our Public Service values, build skills for future jobs, transform our people practices, and develop our leaders.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will build a system for our people to thrive, with shared values and aspirations for Singapore to succeed.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will bring people of diverse skillsets to work together.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We value our officers and will continue to look after their needs.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: As a diverse workforce, we recognise that officers have different needs at different stages of life.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will consider more flexible practices that better suit our officers’ lifecycle needs.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will continue to invest in developing our leaders and ensure that they have the right values and skills.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Diversity of skills within leadership teams is essential for keeping our system resilient against emerging challenges.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will continue to ensure a strong leadership pipeline.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will do more to hone the managerial and leadership skills of junior leaders.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The Singapore Public Service aims to work in a "whole-of-Nation" manner to deliver a better future and strengthen the trust and bond between the Government and Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will continue to strive to be an enduring pillar for our nation’s success.
